## Learnings (append-only, newest last)

- 2026-08-24 (seed): The confidence map handed to QA is the highest-leverage artifact
  this stage produces — honest "I'm not sure about X" entries get bugs caught in dev
  instead of staging.

- 2026-09-08 [feat-20260908-status-version · 03-coding] 2026-09-08: When extending an exact-shape JSON payload, update both the exact-key assertion and empty-payload expectation in addition to adding focused field tests, because those regression checks intentionally reject otherwise additive schema changes.
- 2026-09-08 [feat-20260908-note-delete · 03-coding.api] 2026-09-09: Adding deletion to an in-memory store exposes collisions when new ids are derived from the current item count; test delete-then-create or preserve a monotonic allocator because gaps make the count differ from the next free id.
- 2026-09-08 [feat-20260908-note-delete · 03-coding.api] 2026-09-09: A missing-record deletion test should keep a sentinel record and assert it remains, because an empty-store assertion cannot detect an implementation that reports failure while destructively clearing unrelated state.
- 2026-09-08 [feat-20260908-note-delete · 03-coding.api] 2026-09-09: When deletion reports whether a record existed, determine success from key membership rather than payload truthiness because valid falsey values must still be deleted and reported as present.
- 2026-09-08 [feat-20260908-note-delete · 03-coding.docs] 2026-09-09: In a parallel docs-only builder, document the exact approved interface and outcomes without depending on the sibling branch, because sibling code is unavailable until integration and contract drift must be caught at the merge seam.
- 2026-09-08 [feat-20260908-note-delete · 03-coding.docs] 2026-09-09: Before a path-scoped Python builder hands off, remove generated `__pycache__` directories and use `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` for local reruns, because the write-scope gate counts untracked bytecode outside the builder's approved paths.
- 2026-09-08 [feat-20260908-note-delete · 03-coding.docs] 2026-09-09: If a post-test write-scope check repeatedly sees Python bytecode and the scoped builder cannot add a root `.gitignore`, use repository-local `.git/info/exclude` entries; one-time deletion is insufficient because the gate's own plain Python invocation recreates the caches.
- 2026-09-08 [feat-20260908-note-delete · 03-coding.integrate] 2026-09-09: At D18 integration, inspect tracked generated artifacts as well as test results, because an auto-committed builder handoff can merge bytecode that keeps the final branch dirty whenever the gate runs.

- 2026-09-08 [feat-20260908-note-delete · 03-coding.docs] nothing durable learned this run: this repeat docs-builder execution confirmed the previously recorded contract-documentation and generated-bytecode write-scope practices.
- 2026-09-08 [feat-20260908-note-delete · 03-coding.integrate] nothing durable learned this run: integration confirmed the already-recorded lesson that tracked generated artifacts must be inspected and removed before the final gate.
- 2026-09-09 [manual · -] nothing durable learned this run: the user only asked an ambiguous capability question and no coding convention or repository insight emerged.
- 2026-09-10 [feat-20260910-agentic-infrastructure · manual-engineering-continuation] 2026-09-10: Before/after source hashes cannot prove which mutable code a test executed; use a separate read-only committed snapshot and a modify/test/restore negative control.
- 2026-09-10 [feat-20260910-agentic-infrastructure · manual-engineering-continuation] 2026-09-10: Persist immutable provider identity, base revision, and the observed old remote ref before publication; a confirmed local effect receipt is insufficient after a provider ref or PR moves, so reobserve before reuse and before opening the human gate.
- 2026-09-10 [feat-20260910-agentic-infrastructure · manual-engineering-continuation] 2026-09-11: A missing child intent only proves an external action never started when every version of the parent protocol required that intent first; version new protocols and hold older aggregate attempts rather than retrofit this absence proof.
- 2026-09-10 [manual · -] 2026-09-11: Prefix visual state classes with the component name: a generic .queued rule in chat hid a work-list marker and shifted the entire grid. Browser checks need every state, including queued, because a populated happy-path screenshot missed this collision.
- 2026-09-10 [feat-20260910-agentic-infrastructure · manual-engineering-continuation] 2026-09-11: PostgreSQL UPDATE predicates use a statement snapshot even after waiting for a row lock; serialize maintenance and dispatcher ownership on the parent row, then query conflicting child executions in a fresh statement.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260910-agentic-infrastructure · manual-engineering-continuation] 2026-09-11: A repair tested with a scripted child can still fail in the real stage handoff; exercise artifact writes with every ownership flag and verify the child clone retains the exact base ref before treating parent-loop tests as end-to-end evidence.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260910-agentic-infrastructure · manual-engineering-continuation] 2026-09-11: Join a periodic authority check before a final check reuses its database connection; cancellation must stop owned recorder processes before joining a launcher that can wait for process exit.
- 2026-09-07 [feat-20260907-status-json · 03-coding] 2026-09-07: For a CLI machine-output mode, execute shared database reads before branching into renderers and freeze legacy stdout with exact-string tests, because this preserves query parity and catches accidental compatibility changes.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260911-tender-onboarding · 03-coding] 2026-09-11: A synchronous inbound-message transaction should claim a provider source id, perform one handoff, and persist the reply/event only after successful handoff; this makes ordinary retries idempotent, while the send-before-commit crash window must be documented for a future outbox.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260911-tender-onboarding · 03-coding] 2026-09-11: When a repository tracks setuptools egg-info, `pip install -e` can dirty out-of-scope source metadata before a gate inspects the tree; configure `[tool.distutils.egg_info] egg_base` to an ignored virtual-environment directory because post-command cleanup cannot protect an immediate write-scope check.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260911-tender-onboarding · 03-coding] 2026-09-11: When a coding retry starts from a fresh checkout after a gate failure, verify and fast-forward the prior attempt's stage `branch.bundle` instead of recreating changes, because the bundle preserves exact reviewed commits while avoiding history rewrites and implementation drift.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260911-tender-onboarding · 03-coding.fix] 2026-09-11: A uniqueness-race handler must roll back the failed ORM transaction and then re-read the exact tenant-scoped deduplication key before treating the error as a duplicate, because a failed session cannot query safely and unrelated integrity violations must still surface.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260911-tender-onboarding · 03-coding] 2026-09-11: A duplicate-delivery race guard must cover the earliest unique insert in the transaction—including conversation get-or-create, not just the source-message claim—because concurrent first-contact requests can collide before the nominal deduplication row is flushed.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260911-tender-onboarding · 03-coding] nothing durable learned this run: attempt 4 only revalidated an already reviewer-approved clean branch, and the existing coding memory already covers its relevant gate and concurrency lessons.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260911-tender-onboarding · 03-coding] 2026-09-11: If a repository tracks generated `*.egg-info`, remove and ignore it instead of redirecting generation into a virtualenv, because redirects keep stale dependency/source manifests in version control and conceal contradictory packaging metadata from maintainers and scanners.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260911-tender-onboarding · 03-coding] 2026-09-11: A rework decision that requires changing previously out-of-scope tracked paths must widen the approved write-scope envelope before coding runs, because coding-stage tools cannot mutate upstream plan artifacts and otherwise the exact human-authorized fix is mechanically rejected.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260911-tender-onboarding · 03-coding] 2026-09-11: A cookie-tamper regression should alter an early character of the encoded signature, not its final Base64 character, because changing unused trailing bits can produce a different string that decodes to identical signature bytes and makes the test flaky.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260911-tender-onboarding · 03-coding] nothing durable learned this run: attempt 6 applied the now-approved scope amendment and revalidated fixes already captured by prior coding memory entries.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260911-tender-onboarding · 03-coding] 2026-09-11: A multi-key in-memory throttle should check all dimensions atomically and avoid storing new identity buckets for denied requests, because partial consumption skews limits and attacker-controlled identifiers can otherwise turn the limiter itself into a memory-exhaustion path.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260911-tender-onboarding · 03-coding.fix] 2026-09-11: Multi-dimensional route throttles need tests that vary one identity dimension while holding the other below its limit, plus a spy on the expensive service boundary, because same-IP/same-account status-only tests can pass even when an entire limiter key or the early-return placement is missing.
- 2026-09-11 [feat-20260911-tender-onboarding · 03-coding] 2026-09-11: Wizard order is not a server-side invariant when persistent navigation exposes later steps; guard prerequisite state on both GET and POST and again at the shared service boundary, because a fresh authenticated user can otherwise bypass the intended sequence and turn a missing profile into a 500.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-catalog-orders · 03-coding] 2026-09-12: In deterministic multi-product text extraction, bind a quantity only when it is grammatically adjacent to that product phrase; choosing the nearest earlier number causes a line with no quantity to inherit a previous line's quantity and bypass the required clarification.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-catalog-orders · 03-coding.fix] 2026-09-12: Confirmation idempotency must atomically claim the persisted summarized draft before creating an order, because source-message deduplication only protects retries with the same provider id and two distinct `yes` messages can otherwise create duplicate orders.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-catalog-orders · 03-coding] 2026-09-12: A shared inbound transaction must inspect an outbound adapter's acceptance receipt, not merely the absence of an exception, before committing its draft/order/transcript; providers can return syntactically successful responses that reject the handoff.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-catalog-orders · 03-coding.fix] 2026-09-12: A two-sided conversational replacement needs the unresolved half persisted explicitly—either the new candidate awaiting an old-line target or the unavailable old line awaiting a new candidate—because returning clarification text without durable draft state makes the next otherwise valid answer impossible to apply.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-catalog-orders · 03-coding] 2026-09-12: Sequential conversational recovery must persist each accepted replacement and advance the pending target before returning the next clarification; otherwise the next turn reloads stale state and loops on the first unavailable line forever.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-catalog-orders · 03-coding] 2026-09-12: Once Alembic owns deployed schema, application startup must not call `create_all`; keep any test bootstrap explicit because otherwise starting the app after a downgrade silently recreates tables and defeats rollback.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-catalog-orders · 03-coding.fix] 2026-09-12: Seller-facing money must be formatted from integer minor units through one Decimal-based helper on every template, because leaving even one list view on `value / 100` reintroduces binary-float rounding at accepted BigInteger prices.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-catalog-orders · 03-coding] nothing durable learned this run: attempt 5 only revalidated an already reviewer-approved R-17 branch; the separate PC-6 documentation finding requires an approved write-scope amendment rather than a coding workaround.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-catalog-orders · 03-coding] 2026-09-12: When startup schema creation is removed in favor of Alembic, update both executable developer command references and smoke-test migrate-then-serve from an absent database in the same change, because a healthy process alone does not prove database-backed routes work.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-catalog-orders · 03-coding] 2026-09-12: A retry-safe external notification needs a durable pre-send outbox state plus a stable provider correlation key; after an accepted-send/local-commit failure, retries must reconcile that key and withhold resending until acceptance is known.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-catalog-orders · 03-coding] 2026-09-12: Under a path-enforced rework, preserve a health endpoint's existing success payload and place new migration-readiness assertions in an approved schema test module, because an otherwise correct regression outside write scope blocks the entire handoff.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-escalations · 03-coding] 2026-09-12: Consecutive conversational fallback detection requires monotonically advancing persisted reply timestamps, because provider timestamps can tie or arrive out of order and timestamp-plus-random-ID ordering does not reliably identify the immediately previous turn.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-escalations · 03-coding.fix] 2026-09-12: A recoverable outbound-reply form must stay bound to its unresolved delivery idempotency key and suppress new sends while that delivery is uncertain, because rotating the form nonce after rejection or timeout can duplicate customer messages and leave stale rows blocking hand-back.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-escalations · 03-coding] 2026-09-12: A browser-reachable private HTTP public origin needs a false-by-default explicit insecure override plus a startup warning, because changing only the origin can otherwise crash-loop the app before QA can verify the generated link.
- 2026-09-12 [feat-20260911-tender-escalations · 03-coding] 2026-09-12: When one conversation can be escalated repeatedly, project the latest event for actions and unread state plus a separate answered-event history for response metrics, because a latest-only model silently hides valid per-event durations.
